provenance: Team-authored 54-item out-of-distribution (OOD) sanity-check set (not an independent utility-labeled dataset), grounded in public GERC Supply Code 2015, GERC Standard of Performance clauses, public Gujarat Electricity Ombudsman / CGRF terminology, and colloquial North Gujarat Hinglish/Gujarati-transliterated phrasings. Contains zero private citizen PII and verified zero template overlap with synthetic.py.
